classes.name: CLA
classes.description: A class implementing the Critical Line Algorithm for portfolio optimization, used to calculate the efficient frontier and optimal asset weights.

methods.name: CLA
methods.description: Constructor method for initializing the CLA object with expected returns and covariance matrix.

methods.name: efficient_frontier
methods.description: Calculates and returns the set of portfolios on the efficient frontier, including their returns, volatility, and asset weights.
